findings.title: ws_breaker sticks in GAP_DETECTED forever: observe_success() has no GAP_DETECTED heal branch — live-confirmed wrong surface_state disclosure
findings.detail: Amendment gap_scan_loop (service.py:349-364) sets ws_breaker.state = 'GAP_DETECTED' directly on >10 s quote silence, and on_ws_event (service.py:140-141) calls observe_success() to heal — but CircuitBreaker.observe_success() (circuit.py:322-331) transitions only RATE_LIMITED/DEGRADED/RECOVERING/DISCONNECTED to HEALTHY; GAP_DETECTED falls through both branches and never heals. Live at audit time: /v1/status ws CONNECTED, 2,087,229 messages, reconnect_count 0, last_message current — yet ws_breaker.state='GAP_DETECTED' stuck since the startup transient at 02:25:30Z (flagged before the first quote arrived), and every /v1/prices/latest payload discloses surface_state='GAP_DETECTED' while the quote surface is healthy. The amendment made surface_state THE designated truth channel for ws-down ('ws-down no longer forces DISCONNECTED on marks (surface_state discloses)'), so a stuck-wrong value defeats that law in steady state. Mitigating: datum status and canonical_current are unaffected (only RATE_LIMITED forces datum status; marks stayed HEALTHY/canonical_current true), and /v1/status ws.state remains truthful.
findings.remediation: Add 'GAP_DETECTED' to the observe_success() heal list (or have gap_scan_loop clear the state when quotes resume) + one regression test: flag GAP via scan, deliver a quote, assert breaker HEALTHY and payload surface_state HEALTHY.

Impact bounded: these are display/diagnostic fields; the canary and marks math never consume them.
findings.file_line: research/live_gateway/service.py:436-452 (apply_rest_mark call passes None); live payload funding_rate=null
findings.remediation: Parse entry['lastFundingRate'] and entry['nextFundingTime'] in mark_poll_loop and pass them through apply_rest_mark (extend its signature); amend the plan wording or the code — they must agree.

findings.title: Debugging-trail intermediate commit messages state causal claims as measured facts that were confounded by the then-unresolved doubled-/stream URL
findings.detail: 681abb93 ('heartbeat=20 connections get killed ... while identical streams without client heartbeat flow') and e133cb03 ('fresh session flows 4126 frames/8s while the gateway's REST-shared session got 0 msgs') attribute the silent-WS failure to heartbeat/shared-session; the 'flowing' baselines were direct probes with the CORRECT URL while the gateway still used the doubled /stream/stream path, so the comparisons were not apples-to-apples. The final commit c23b5e87 explicitly corrects the record ('masqueraded as payload suppression for the gateway'; 'heartbeat-removal + dedicated-session changes kept (harmless, defensively good)'), so the trail self-corrects and the sequence adds up (amendment 09:14:42 -> ops fix 09:18:53 -> ops fix 09:20:58 -> diagnostic 09:22:10 -> root cause 09:25:30 +0700, matching events.jsonl quote_gap storm 02:14-02:25Z and the 02:25:30Z restart to pid 55713).
findings.file_line: git commits 681abb93, e133cb03 vs corrected-by c23b5e87
findings.remediation: No code change (messages immutable); cycle evidence note should cite c23b5e87 as the authoritative causal account so later readers do not inherit the heartbeat/shared-session causal claim.

findings.title: Diagnostic commit be5ada3d claims 'surface in stream stats' but last_error is never surfaced anywhere
findings.detail: The commit only adds the last_error attribute (wsadapter.py:57) and records it in the run() except path (wsadapter.py:88); BinanceStream.stats() (wsadapter.py:139-150) does not include it and service.py never reads it, so the diagnostic is stored on the object and displayed nowhere. Additionally the actual broken-URL failure mode was a clean close with NO exception, which this diagnostic could not capture — the visible giveaway was the doubled stream_url that stats() does expose.
findings.remediation: Add last_error to BinanceStream.stats() (and/or the /v1/status ws block) so the commit's stated purpose is realized.

summary: AUTHORIZED_WITH_FINDINGS: 0 CRITICAL / 0 HIGH / 2 MEDIUM / 5 LOW. Amendment 1 is faithfully implemented at c23b5e87: the WS surface is bookTicker quote-only on exactly BTC/ETH/SOL with no code path that can turn a quote into a mark (apply_quote touches quote fields only; build_payload mark/value come only from the mark clock); marks come from REST premiumIndex every 5 s through the full section-5 law (live-measured 11.4-11.6 calls/min, weight 110-120/min vs soft 1200); the amended freshness law (STALE 30 s, mark GAP >10 s, quote GAP >10 s, canonical_current == HEALTHY, ws-down disclosed via surface_state instead of forcing DISCONNECTED) is in code and tests; leg A is REST-vs-REST at ALIGN_WINDOW_MS 6 s with presence/within-5bps/hard thresholds untouched; the old-law environment-block record is preserved and matches the amendment's 5%-aligned claim. Measured suite 74/74 (arithmetic reconciles). Live: mark served from rest_premium_index with best bid/ask present and HEALTHY, ws CONNECTED with messages growing and 0 reconnects, loopback-only bind, all four worker pids + canary driver alive; leg B's retry loop was demonstrated live (attempt 1 connection-refused at the restart, attempt 2 a clean HTTP-429 fail-closed abort per the frozen law, driver continuing). The amendment's suppression premise was independently re-corroborated by my own bounded probe (markPrice 0 frames/10 s vs flowing bookTicker on identical recipe). The two MEDIUMs: (1) ws_breaker sticks in GAP_DETECTED with no heal path, so the surface_state disclosure channel — the amendment's designated truth channel — currently reads GAP_DETECTED in steady state while the WS is fully healthy (live-confirmed; datum status/canonical_current unaffected); (2) the amendment's 'mark/index/funding come from REST premiumIndex' is only 2/3 implemented — funding_rate/next_funding_time are never parsed and are permanently null. LOWs: confounded intermediate causal claims in two ops-fix commit messages (self-corrected by c23b5e87), the 'surface in stream stats' diagnostic claim not actually surfaced, the undisclosed ws_freshness_probe removal with dead counters, stale docstrings still stating the old law, and uncommitted single-copy canary evidence files. Remediate both MEDIUMs before the G3 adjudication window closes if practical (they do not gate leg A/B math); canary adjudication stays WAITING (24 h window ~2026-09-23T02:16Z).
